clue.text: Given no option about a meal in the police canteen?

definitions.text: Given no option about a meal in the police canteen?

parts.words: Given no option about a meal in the police canteen?
parts.note: the police are 'the force', and anyone eating in their canteen has been fed by the force; the phrase also means made to eat against one's will

explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as two words: what the force (the police) did for a diner in its canteen.
explanation.definitionFit: To be made to eat without choice is the plain sense; the police pun is the cryptic second reading.

clue.text: Take in too much conversation, perhaps, as eavesdropper may

definitions.text: Take in too much conversation, perhaps, as eavesdropper may

parts.words: Take in too much conversation, perhaps, as eavesdropper may
parts.note: split the answer as 'too much' plus 'take in (by ear)', and you have what an eavesdropper does to a conversation

explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as two parts: 'over' (too much) and 'hear' (take in by ear); together they mean to catch talk not meant for you.
explanation.definitionFit: An eavesdropper listens secretly to other people's talk, catching words not intended for them.

clue.text: Help with harvest? Not all Irish do slapdash work

parts.note: harvesting means you cut corn

indicators.note: not all of the word for Irish is used: its final letter is dropped

parts.note: Erse is the Irish Gaelic language

explanation.surface: A farm labourer helps at harvest, but some of the Irish workers skimp on the job.
explanation.definitionFit: To take shortcuts is the idiom: skimping on proper procedure to finish a task faster.

clue.text: Supports for "floater" and "stinger|" showing unexpected weakness

parts.note: your feet support you
'of' standing for 'for', as in 'the cry of help'
Cassius Clay (Muhammad Ali) boasted he would 'float like a butterfly, sting like a bee'

explanation.surface: Something holds up two oddly named things, revealing a hidden flaw.
explanation.walkthrough: The quoted words point to the boxer Cassius Clay, later Muhammad Ali, whose famous boast was to float like a butterfly and sting like a bee.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical idiom names a hidden flaw in someone otherwise admired, from the statue in Daniel.

clue.text: Proud to put out and leave course

indicators.note: letters that are put out are disturbed and displaced into a new order

explanation.surface: A haughty student, upset, quits their studies.
explanation.definitionFit: To abandon a college programme or race before finishing is the phrasal verb's sense.

clue.text: Poet's endless stream

indicators.note: without its end, so the final letter goes

parts.note: Robert Burns, Scotland's national poet; the 's supplies the final S

explanation.surface: A poet writes of a never-ending brook.
explanation.definitionFit: In Scotland and northern England a burn is a small river or brook.

clue.text: Chap with stories for some other time

parts.note: a chap is a man
ana is a collection of anecdotes or sayings about a person

explanation.surface: A storyteller always promises his tales for later.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish word for tomorrow is used in English for an indefinite later date.

clue.text: Private Society avoided admitting Conservative

indicators.note: letting another letter in, so it is placed inside

parts.note: eluded means avoided
C is the political abbreviation for Conservative

explanation.surface: An exclusive club kept out, but let in, a Tory member.
explanation.definitionFit: A secluded place is hidden away from others, out of public view.

clue.text: Witch wearing make up perhaps important element of diet

indicators.note: the witch is inside the make-up she has on

parts.note: rouge is a cosmetic for the cheeks
a hag is an ugly old witch

explanation.surface: A witch in make-up seems to be offering dietary advice.
explanation.definitionFit: Dietary fibre, the indigestible plant matter that aids digestion, is essential for health.

clue.text: Way I must feed small dog

indicators.note: to feed is to go into, so these letters go inside

parts.note: wee is Scottish for small
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Someone is told to give food to their little dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A West Highland white terrier is a small Scottish breed known by this nickname.

clue.text: Quickly wash baby and prepare vegetables

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to wash just a baby's face and bottom
second meaning: to trim both ends off beans or gooseberries

explanation.walkthrough: Two domestic chores share one phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means cleaning or trimming only the two ends, whether of an infant or of produce.

clue.text: Unusual, having day off to see dam

indicators.note: the day's letter is taken off the word

parts.note: weird means unusual

explanation.surface: Something odd happens when someone takes a holiday to visit a dam.
explanation.definitionFit: A low barrier across a river that holds back water is a kind of dam.

clue.text: Coach under way past square

indicators.note: the second part comes after the first

parts.note: four is a square number, two times two
in hand means already being dealt with

explanation.surface: A bus has set off and is travelling past a town square.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coach' looks like a bus or a trainer, but it is the horse-drawn sort.
explanation.definitionFit: A four-in-hand is a carriage drawn by four horses driven by one person.

clue.text: In retreat, keep following banned subject for trade

indicators.note: the keep comes after the other piece

parts.note: the ivory trade is internationally banned
a keep is the main tower of a castle

explanation.surface: A tradesman hides away, persisting with a forbidden line of business.
explanation.definitionFit: An ivory tower is a sheltered refuge from practical realities, often of academics.

clue.text: Admit NHS is struggling and inconsistent

indicators.note: struggling letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Britain's health service is admitted to be struggling and patchy.
explanation.walkthrough: The NHS is Britain's National Health Service.
explanation.definitionFit: Hit-and-miss describes results that are erratic, sometimes successful and sometimes not.

clue.text: Regular signal to stop reversing through airport

indicators.note: the airport's letters run through the other piece, holding it

parts.note: Orly is a Paris airport

indicators.note: the stop signal is read backwards

parts.note: a red light means stop

explanation.surface: A traffic light halts a car backing out at an airport.
explanation.definitionFit: Orderly means neat and methodical, regular in arrangement.

clue.text: Golden pepper shortly providing yellow pigment

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

indicators.note: cut short, so its last letter goes

parts.note: a pimento is a sweet red pepper

explanation.surface: A golden pepper, briefly, is a source for a yellow paint.
explanation.definitionFit: Orpiment is arsenic trisulphide, a mineral formerly ground for a golden-yellow colour.

clue.text: Argue over number in diplomatic body

indicators.note: the other pieces go inside the diplomatic body

parts.note: CD is corps diplomatique
on, as in on top of
ten is a number

explanation.surface: Diplomats squabble about a figure.
explanation.definitionFit: To contend is to assert or maintain in debate.

clue.text: Lincoln's state banker failing: only a shilling in it

indicators.note: the named letters go inside the reworked word
a failing banker is in collapse, so the word is jumbled

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for the old British shilling

explanation.surface: A US banker goes bust in Lincoln's time, with only a shilling to his name.
explanation.walkthrough: Lincoln here is the state capital, not the president; a shilling was a pre-decimal British coin.
explanation.definitionFit: Lincoln is the capital city of this Great Plains US state.

clue.text: Zone round edge of Mestre available as refuge from Venice

indicators.note: the zone goes round the other letters

parts.note: a belt is a zone or region

indicators.note: the first letter of the town's name

parts.note: Mestre is a mainland district of Venice
on, as in on offer

explanation.surface: An area around Mestre offers shelter from Venice's crowds.
explanation.walkthrough: Belmont is Portia's estate in Shakespeare's The Merchant of Venice, away from the city.
explanation.definitionFit: In the play, Portia's country house is a retreat from the commercial city's troubles.

clue.text: Look curiously around storage unit at residence, one for clergy

indicators.note: the snooping goes round the other pieces

parts.note: to pry is to look nosily
a byte is a unit of computer storage

explanation.surface: Someone snoops around a storage facility at a home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one' refers back to 'residence': a residence for clergy.
explanation.definitionFit: A presbytery is a priest's house, especially in the Roman Catholic church.

clue.text: Trimming on robe I claim uncertainly?

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitation
saying 'mine' claims something

explanation.surface: Someone hesitantly claims a robe's trimming as theirs.
explanation.definitionFit: Ermine, white stoat fur, edges the ceremonial robes of peers and judges.

clue.text: Would be important person with his writers

definitions.text: Would be important person with his

definitions.meaning: second meaning: pen points that do the writing

explanation.walkthrough: Put 'his' before the answer and you have a mocking name for a pompous man.
explanation.definitionFit: The pen points are the writing tips; 'his nibs' mocks someone acting grand.

clue.text: Two members of family, one failing to finish crossword? Nonsense

indicators.note: the second family member stops short of his last letter

parts.note: mum and boy are family members
the Times Jumbo is its large prize crossword

explanation.surface: Two relatives, one unable to complete the puzzle, think it all gibberish.
explanation.definitionFit: Mumbo jumbo is meaningless or obscure talk or ritual.

clue.text: Line added to US soldier's very short book

indicators.note: the line's letter is put after the soldier

parts.note: GI Joe is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A GI's brief book gets an extra line.
explanation.definitionFit: Joel is one of the shortest books of the Old Testament, among the minor prophets.

clue.text: The reason that keeps one writing fantasy

indicators.note: it holds the other letters inside

parts.note: why means the reason
I is the Roman numeral one
MS is a manuscript

explanation.surface: Someone explains what motivates them to write fiction.
explanation.definitionFit: Whimsy is playful or fanciful humour or imagination.

clue.text: One short of a score regularly unfit, even after practice

indicators.note: every other letter is taken

parts.note: nets are cricket practice
e'en is poetic for even

explanation.surface: A sports player is unfit even after training.
explanation.definitionFit: A number one less than twenty is the plain arithmetic.

clue.text: Blind prophet wearies one, equally

parts.note: tires means wearies
I is the Roman numeral one
as, as in as good

explanation.surface: A blind seer exhausts a man and an equally fine woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiresias is the Theban seer of Greek myth, blinded by the gods.
